osm_tags.description:
Black dredged with the discharge pipeline, called the dredge 
string or "stinger," trailing downstream. The pipeline was 
mounted on small pontoon barges and could be swung from side to side to allow shifting of the discharge area.
osm_tags.operator: National Mississippi River Museum and Aquarium
osm_tags.protection_title: National Mississippi River Museum and Aquarium

osm_tags.description:
The dredge tender Tavern was used to assist Black, is 
retained by the Musevim and is in excellent condition. Tenders are essentially small towboats. Tavern is 43'3" long 12'6" in length, and drew 2'8" of water when loaded.
osm_tags.name: Tavern
osm_tags.operator: National Mississippi River Museum and Aquarium
osm_tags.protection_title: National Mississippi River Museum and Aquarium
osm_tags.seamark:name: Tavern

osm_tags.description: USCGC Wyaconda is a 75' river buoy tender that maintains buoys and other aids to navigation on the Mississippi River from Clinton, IA to Minneapolis, MN; the Minnesota River to Shakopee, MN; and the St. Croix River to Stillwater, MN.
osm_tags.name: USCGC Wyaconda
